Use `field_simp` to clear the denominators in the goal, then combine the resulting equation with `Complex.I_mul_I`:

```lean
by
  have h : i * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    calc
      i * (2 - Complex.I) = i * z := by rw [h₂]
      _ = v := h₀.symm
      _ = 1 + Complex.I := h₁
  field_simp
  linear_combination (2 + Complex.I) * h + i * Complex.I_mul_I
```

The linear combination multiplies `h` by `2 + Complex.I` and uses `Complex.I_mul_I` to simplify the square of `Complex.I`.
